Policeman: Dear citizen, what are you doing at this hour? In this area?
You: Uhh… Just walking around?
Policeman: ‘Just walking around’ he says. Get a load of this guy!
Policewoman: Sir, it’s freezing cold and it’s {gv_Hour} at night. Are you sure you are just walking around?
You: Yeah?
#Policeman.Face.lookateachother
#Policewoman.Face.lookateachother
I don’t get it, is it really that weird?
Policeman and Policewoman: …
#Policeman.Face.normal
#Policewoman.Face.normal
Policeman: Please turn around with your hands behind your back.
You: W-why?!
Policewoman: Woah, woah, calm down, it’s too fast for that partner. We wouldn’t want any civil rights issues now wouldn’t we?
Policeman: Y-yeah, good call. I just thought that you agreed with me during that long, silent stare.
Policewoman: No no no, it was a ‘proceed with caution’ stare. Besides, you should know better, aren’t you on your third misconduct case?
#Policeman.Face.angry
Policeman: You don’t have to tell me, ok?! 
#Policeman.Face.normal
Policeman: I’m just…{{wi}} not very good at working under pressure. Sometimes I even get twitchy and stuff.
Policewoman: …
Policewoman: Well, let’s talk about it later.
Policewoman: Sir, your name please.
You: Anon [Redacted].
Policeman: Anon [Redacted]?! What kind of name is that?! Is that even a real name?
You: …
Policewoman: Anyway, do you live nearby?
You: Yes, just a few minutes away.
Policeman: Oh really? I don’t remember your face at all.
You: W-what? We literally talked not so long ago!
Policeman: Oh, uh, right. I was just testing you.
Policewoman: Excuse my partner, he’s not good at remembering faces. You live in that big complex nearby, if I remember correctly.
Policewoman: Would you mind showing us your ID sir?
Uh, I forgot if I’m forced to show my ID in this state or not. Let’s just cooperate to get this thing over with.
You: Here.
Policewoman: …
Policewoman: Everything seems alright. 
Policewoman: Please sir, go back to your home, there’s a little disturbance down the road and we don’t want you to hinder our investigation.
You: Did something bad happen?
Policewoman: Nothing you should be concerned with, but please close your windows upon your arrival.
Policewoman: Also, you can experience a little headache and nosebleed in the coming hours, but it’s a normal occurrence. The weather is acting up, you see.
You: O-ok?
That seems strange
Policeman: Are you letting him go just like that? You know, he might be one of them.
Policewoman: There’s nothing much we can do, it’s not like we have any well-grounded suspicion.
Policeman: Can I at least pat him down? I always wanted to try it once!
Policewoman: Alright alright, just do it quickly. I don’t want to breathe it in any longer.
Policeman: Turn around and hands on the wall, scum! I will now pat you down in search of dangerous weapons.
